title: Why the US-Iran war continues to disrupt oil markets - The Economic Times
text:
The oil market is witnessing unprecedented volatility amid the intensifying US-Iran hostilities. Iran's surprising maneuver to shut down the critical Hormuz waterway has caught the attention of global investors. President Trump’s inconsistent remarks have also played a pivotal role in shaping market reactions. Despite the rise in crude prices, they remain below expert expectations.
